statement: T2_TREND_GLOBEX: hold the daily trend direction from the Globex reopen (17:00 CT) to 15:00 CT next day - inside one Topstep trading day (starts 5:00 PM CT, flat by 3:10 PM CT); captures the overnight part where T1's diagnostic located the trend P&L. Weekend gap (Fri 15:00 CT -> Sun 17:00 CT) and 15:00-17:00 CT are not held.
mechanism: trend premium accrual during the day session
falsification: {"DEV": "pooled net Sharpe >= 0.5 AND >= 60% instruments with positive net mean", "VAL": "pooled net Sharpe >= 0.3", "TEST": "net Sharpe > 0 at 1x and >= 0 at 2x", "FRESH": "pooled net mean > 0"}
